info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Realestate Listings Offer-v3-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings Offer API allows users to create and manage offers on property listings. This endpoint facilitates the submission of prospective offers for real estate listings, enabling buyers to express their interest in specific properties. Typical consumers of this API include real estate agents, property management companies, and developers looking to streamline the offer process. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their real estate platforms and improve user engagement in property transactions.

post.summary: Create a new offer for a listing.
post.description: This operation allows users to create an offer for a specific listing by providing necessary details. It ensures that the offer is associated with the correct listing and provides feedback on the success or failure of the operation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit an offer for listings. It should contain all the necessary details about the offer being made, including the listing ID, offer price, and any additional terms or conditions.
